# All motion goes through the public client. Targets and observations are recorded.
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from kin import fk,point,J,L
names=spec['action_types']['joint_position']['layout']
ranges=np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['range_rad'])

def getq(res):return np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now'][:69])
def radians_action(q):
    vals=[]
    for n in names:
        j=n.replace('_A_','_')
        if j.endswith('J0'):v=q[J.index(j[:-1]+'1')]+q[J.index(j[:-1]+'2')]
        else:v=q[J.index(j)]
        vals.append(v)
    return np.clip(2*(np.array(vals)-ranges[:,0])/(ranges[:,1]-ranges[:,0])-1,-1,1)

def baseq():
    q=np.zeros(69)
    q[[2,7]]=-.4;q[[3,8]]=.8;q[[4,9]]=-.4
    return q

def ik(q,side,target,orientation=None,local_point=None):
    idx=list(range(11,18)) if side=='left' else list(range(40,47))
    link='lh_palm' if side=='left' else 'rh_palm'
    p=np.array(local_point if local_point is not None else ([.43,.214,.087] if side=='left' else [.43,-.214,.087]))
    lim=[]
    for i in idx:
        n=J[i] if i not in [16,17,45,46] else J[i].replace('_','_A_')
        lim.append(ranges[names.index(n)])
    lim=np.array(lim)
    q0=q.copy()
    def fun(x):
        qq=q.copy();qq[idx]=x;T=fk(qq)[link]
        err=list((point(T,p)-target)*15)
        if orientation is not None:err.extend(Rotation.from_matrix(orientation.T@T[:3,:3]).as_rotvec()*.7)
        err.extend((x-q0[idx])*.04)
        return err
    fit=least_squares(fun,np.clip(q[idx],lim[:,0]+1e-5,lim[:,1]-1e-5),bounds=(lim[:,0],lim[:,1]),max_nfev=150)
    q[idx]=fit.x
    print('IK',side,'point',point(fk(q)[link],p).round(3),'angles',q[idx].round(3))
    return q

def move(q,steps=20,label='move',start=None):
    if start is None:
        prev=OUT/'last_target.npy'
        a0=np.load(prev) if prev.exists() else radians_action(getq(r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none')))
    else:a0=radians_action(start)
    a1=radians_action(q)
    A=np.array([a0+(a1-a0)*(i+1)/steps for i in range(steps)])
    log=OUT/'actions.jsonl'
    with log.open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'label':label,'actions':A.tolist()})+'\n')
    res=r.submit('joint_position',A,cameras=None,video='none',note=label)
    res.save(OUT/label);res.save(OUT/'latest');np.save(OUT/'last_target.npy',a1);np.save(OUT/'target_q.npy',q)
    now=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now'])
    print('STEP',res.meta['control_steps'],'DONE',res.done,'IMU',now[-6:].round(3),'legs',now[:11].round(3))
    return res

def estimate(res):
    now=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now']);q=now[:69]
    R=Rotation.align_vectors([[0,0,-1]],[now[-3:]])[0].as_matrix()
    T=fk(q)
    init=json.load(open(OUT/'initial/meta.json'));qi=np.array(init['proprio']['now'][:69]);Ri=Rotation.align_vectors([[0,0,-1]],[init['proprio']['now'][-3:]])[0].as_matrix();Ti=fk(qi)
    pfeet=[np.array([.04,.203,-1.065]),np.array([.04,-.203,-1.065])]
    footlinks=['left_ankle_link','right_ankle_link']
    anch=[Ri@point(Ti[n],p) for n,p in zip(footlinks,pfeet)]
    z=-np.mean([p[2] for p in anch]);anch=[p+[0,0,z] for p in anch]
    base=np.mean([a-R@point(T[n],p) for a,n,p in zip(anch,footlinks,pfeet)],axis=0)
    hands={s:R@point(T[n],[.43,y,.087])+base for s,n,y in [('left','lh_palm',.214),('right','rh_palm',-.214)]}
    print('base estimate',base.round(3),'hand estimates',hands)
    return R,base

def worldik(q,side,target,res,orientation=None):
    R,b=estimate(res)
    return ik(q,side,R.T@(np.array(target)-b),None if orientation is None else R.T@orientation)

steps.cmd:
python - <<'PY'
p='/app/output/gen.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("if __name__=='__main__':\n    res=observe('initial')\n    print(json.dumps(r.status()))\n    print(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))\n",'')
s+='''\n\ndef replay_recorded_episode():
    """Replay the exact submitted targets through the public client; never reset."""
    status=r.status()
    if status['done']:
        print(json.dumps(status))
        return
    if status['control_steps'] != 0:
        raise RuntimeError('Replay requires a fresh service episode; this script never resets.')
    commands=[json.loads(line) for line in (OUT/'actions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    for i, command in enumerate(commands):
        res=r.submit('joint_position',np.asarray(command['actions']),dt=0.02,
                     interpolate='linear',cameras=None,video='none',note=command['label'])
        res.save(OUT/'replay'/f"{i:03d}_{command['label']}")
        if res.done:
            break
    print(json.dumps(r.status()))

if __name__=='__main__':
    replay_recorded_episode()
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
import json
commands=[json.loads(x) for x in open('/app/output/actions.jsonl')]
print('Recorded chunks:',len(commands),'steps:',sum(len(x['actions']) for x in commands))
compile(s,p,'exec')
PY
